title: Lanterns After Closing
form: 32-bar AABA in 3/4: head (1-32), tenor chorus (33-64), piano half-chorus (65-80), out head from the bridge (81-96) with ritardando and a rubato fermata; the loop is bars 17-80

ending.howTo: To finish the tune instead of looping, let playback run on past loopEnd to the end of the file: the out head (bars 81-96) follows seamlessly and ends on a fermata.

durationNote: duration is the rendered length; an MP3 decoder (Chromium, libmpg123) returns decodedDuration, which is longer by the encoder's final-frame padding (silence).
